shared_elements: standing human figure in profile/frontal action pose
figure holding an object in raised hand
concentric circle / disc motif (as shield, sun-disc or wristlet rosette)
figures carrying weapon-like or staff-like implements
justification: Both surfaces depict upright human-form figures with raised arms holding objects, and both contain concentric-circle discs (large shield-like discs in A, small rosette-wristlets in B), but these are generic and independently common motifs. A is a scatter of tiny stick-figure silhouettes, ships and cup-marks distributed loosely over a field, while B is a single large, anatomically modelled winged figure with detailed drapery, beard and feathering filling one panel — utterly different conventions of depiction, scale relations and composition.
